pool.basis: pre-quota pool swept at ingestion (a sample of Steam, not a census)

claims.claim: Reviewers report technical issues with missing audio and sound effects upon starting the game.
Reviewers describe the user interface as clunky, outdated, and difficult to navigate.
Reviewers note that controller support is poorly implemented, with tutorials assuming keyboard input.
Reviewers state that the game lacks a proper tutorial or onboarding structure, leaving players unguided.
Reviewers encounter navigation bugs where characters get stuck in the environment's mesh geometry.
Reviewers report that the game lacks any tutorial or guidance, leaving players confused and directionless at the start.
Reviewers experience frequent attacks, robberies, and capture by bandits or slavers almost immediately after leaving initial towns.
Reviewers note that characters start off extremely weak, resulting in frequent defeats, limb loss, and being eaten or enslaved.
Reviewers describe inventory and storage systems bugging out by causing characters to endlessly run back and forth to deposit matching items.
Reviewers state that the game features retro controls and graphics that feel dated.
Reviewers describe the opening hours as unguided, lacking a proper tutorial to explain core mechanics.
Reviewers report that pathfinding and AI movement frequently fail, causing units to get stuck on buildings or walk in circles.
Reviewers note that performance is out-of-the-box unoptimized or buggy, but can be mitigated with community mods.
Reviewers experience frequent bugs, crashes, and janky features during gameplay sessions.
Reviewers highlight the game's steep learning curve and extreme difficulty, where getting defeated repeatedly is part of the intended progression.
Reviewers praise the massive, open-ended world and deep sandbox freedom that allows for diverse playstyles.

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the game suffers from frequent crashes, bugs, optimization issues, and lag regardless of hardware quality.
Reviewers note that community-made mods are important for improving quality of life, performance, and addressing missing features.

Reviewers state that the game has no tutorial or hand-holding, requiring players to figure out mechanics on their own.
